title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment
title_zh: 评估生成式图像评估的大规模多模态模型能力的SQUARE-Bench基准

paragraphs.en: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multi-modal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench , a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects, including S emantics, Qu ality, A uthenticity, and Re sponsibility . SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AIGIs sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models ( e.g. , Gemini-3-Pro) already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.
paragraphs.zh: 随着文本到图像（T2I）生成技术的快速发展，构建可靠的评估方法变得至关重要且充满挑战，因为传统指标无法捕捉精细的对应关系和生成性伪影。 尽管大型多模态模型（LMMs）正越来越多地被用作评估工具，但现有基准测试通常孤立地研究语义理解、质量感知和真实性识别，而基本忽略了责任检测。 这导致在统一且全面的验证方面存在空白。 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 SQUARE-Bench——一个综合性基准测试，系统性地从四个方面评估 LMM 作为 AI 生成图像评估工具的能力，包括语义（S emantics）、质量（Qu ality）、真实性（A uthenticity）和责任感（Re sponsibility）。 SQUARE-Bench 引入了一套包含 38 个子维度的精细分类体系，用于评估从 22 种不同模型中采样出的近 10,000 张 AI 生成图像（AIGIs），这些模型涵盖从传统到顶尖的生成器，并辅以超过 3,000 张真实世界图像。 这些图像均标注了精心设计的问答对。 对 23 种 LMM 的大规模实验表明，顶尖的专有模型（例如 Gemini-3-Pro）已经超越了单个专家评估基准的表现。 然而，不同模型之间的性能差距仍然显著，尤其在精细推理和特定领域的稳健性方面存在明显差异。 除了基准测试外，我们还开展了一项 LMM 引导迭代编辑的概念验证研究，其中针对特定维度的 LMM 会向固定的图像编辑器提供诊断反馈。 由此构建的引导系统能在语义、真实性和责任感方面实现选择性提升，但同时也表现出视觉质量上的一致性权衡。 SQUARE-Bench 既可以作为诊断工具来刻画 LMM 评估能力，也可用于研究其在 T2I 生成优化中的应用。 该基准测试和数据集将在论文发表后公开。

paragraphs.en: The field of artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) has advanced rapidly, largely driven by the development of generative models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) . Given a natural language prompt, modern text-to-image (T2I) models can now synthesize high-fidelity and semantically relevant images, enabling broad applications in creative industries, design, and digital entertainment ( Kolors Team and Kuaishou Technology, 2025 ; Google, 2025 ) . Despite these remarkable advances, current models still exhibit notable limitations, they frequently suffer from text-image misalignment, lack fine-grained fidelity, and occasionally produce outputs that violate commonsense physics, aesthetic standards, or safety boundaries. Consequently, robust evaluation mechanisms are indispensable, not only for benchmarking progress but also for constructing high-quality reward models to steer T2I generation through reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Xu et al., 2024a ; Peters and Schaal, 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能生成内容（AIGC）领域发展迅速，其主要驱动力是生成式模型的发展（Rombach 等，2022；Saharia 等，2022）。 给定自然语言提示，现代文本到图像（T2I）模型如今能够合成高保真且语义相关的图像，从而在创意产业、设计和数字娱乐等领域得到广泛应用（Kolors Team 和 Kuaishou Technology，2025；Google，2025）。 尽管取得了这些显著进展，当前模型仍存在明显局限：它们经常面临文本与图像不一致的问题，缺乏精细的细节保真度，偶尔还会生成违反常识物理规律、审美标准或安全边界的输出。 因此，可靠的评估机制不可或缺，这不仅有助于衡量进步，还能构建高质量的奖励模型，通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）来引导 T2I 生成（Xu 等，2023；Liu 等，2025a；Xu 等，2024a；Peters 和 Schaal，2007）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating AI-generated images (AIGIs) is a multifaceted challenge. Traditional metrics generally fail to meet the requirements. Conventional image quality assessment (IQA) methods cannot discern generative artifacts ( e.g. , distorted limbs), while CLIP-based scores ( Radford et al., 2021 ) often fail to capture compositional nuances and human aesthetic preferences ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . To address this, the research community has increasingly explored utilizing large multi-modal models (LMMs) as evaluators, leveraging their human-like reasoning and interpretability ( Hu et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . Although recent LMM-based metrics demonstrate promise via high correlation (SRCC/PLCC) with human judgments, these aggregated scores function as “black boxes”—they validate that an LMM works, but fail to reveal why it works or where it fails.
paragraphs.zh: 评估人工智能生成的图像（AIGIs）是一项多维度的挑战。 传统指标通常无法满足这些要求。 传统的图像质量评估（IQA）方法无法识别生成过程中的伪影（例如，肢体扭曲），而基于CLIP的评分（Radford等，2021）则常常无法捕捉构图细节和人类的美学偏好（Wang等，2025b）。 为了解决这个问题，研究界越来越多地探索使用大型多模态模型（LMMs）作为评估工具，以利用其类人类的推理能力和可解释性（Hu等，2023；Lin等，2024）。 尽管近期基于LMM的指标通过与人类判断的高度相关性（SRCC/PLCC）展现出潜力，但这些聚合评分实际上如同“黑箱”——它们验证了LMM的有效性，却无法揭示其有效的原因或失效之处。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, beyond using LMMs as scoring tools, it is necessary to systematically diagnose their own capabilities and failure modes as AIGI evaluators. However, existing benchmarks exhibit significant limitations. Previous works like A-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) and Q-Bench + ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) predominantly focus on semantic understanding and quality perception . In parallel, FakeBench ( Li et al., 2025b ) and LOKI ( Ye et al., 2024b ) solely target authenticity (synthetic detection). As a result, critical aspects such as responsibility remain insufficiently explored. More importantly, existing benchmarks lack a unified evaluation framework that comprehensively explores the capabilities of LMMs for AIGI assessment, while also failing to provide a sufficiently fine-grained taxonomy for disentangling complex and heterogeneous evaluation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，除了将 LMM 用作评分工具之外，还必须系统性地诊断它们作为 AIGI 评估者的自身能力与失效模式。 然而，现有的基准测试存在明显的局限性。 以往的研究，如 A-Bench（Zhang 等人，2024b）和 Q-Bench+（Zhang 等人，2024c），主要关注语义理解和质量感知。 与此同时，FakeBench（Li 等人，2025b）和 LOKI（Ye 等人，2024b）仅针对真实性（合成内容检测）进行评估。 因此，责任性等关键方面尚未得到充分探索。 更重要的是，现有基准测试缺乏一个统一的评估框架，既无法全面探索 LMM 在 AIGI 评估方面的能力，也未能提供足够精细的分类体系来区分复杂且异构的评估任务。

Moving beyond vague scoring, we employ an expert-driven construction and multi-expert review pipeline to produce approximately 18,000 descriptive, scenario-specific question-answer (QA) pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模混合数据集：我们从 22 个不同的 T2I 模型中收集了近 10,000 个经过精心挑选的 AIGI，以及超过 3,000 张真实世界的图像。 我们不再依赖模糊的评分方式，而是采用由专家主导的构建流程和多专家评审机制，生成了约 18,000 对描述性且针对特定场景的问题-回答（QA）对。

paragraphs.en: Tailored evaluation tasks: Beyond standard QA formats, SQUARE-Bench incorporates specialized designs for distinct sub-dimensions, such as Binary Judgments for authenticity and multi-image reasoning for social fairness , enabling a rigorous assessment of complex LMM reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 定制评估任务：除了标准的问答形式外，SQUARE-Bench 还为不同的子维度融入了专门的设计，例如用于验证真实性的二元判断以及用于社会公平性分析的多图像推理，从而能够严格评估复杂 LMM 的推理能力。

paragraphs.en: Innovative dual-answer mechanism: To bridge generative intent and visual perception, we introduce a “one Question, two Answers” design. For each query, Answer 1 strictly reflects the actual visual content (evaluating pure LMM perception), while Answer 2 describes the expected prompt outcome (establishing a baseline for T2I generation capabilities).

paragraphs.en: Evaluation benchmarks play a pivotal role in advancing the development of large multimodal models (LMMs). Previous benchmarks have evolved from task-specific evaluations like COCO Caption ( Chen et al., 2015 ) and GQA ( Hudson and Manning, 2019 ) to comprehensive suites such as MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , which primarily focus on assessing the broad and sophisticated reasoning capabilities of LMMs on natural images. More recently, as shown in Table 1 , specific benchmarks have emerged to evaluate LMMs in the domain of AI-generated images (AIGIs). Specifically, Q-Bench + ( Zhang et al., 2024c ) assesses low-level visual quality; A-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) targets semantic understanding and quality perception; while datasets like FakeBench ( Li et al., 2025b ) , LOKI ( Ye et al., 2024b ) , FakeClue ( Wen et al., 2025 ) , and DFbench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) concentrate on the authenticity aspect ( i.e. , synthetic detection). Despite these efforts, existing AIGI-oriented benchmarks still tend to evaluate different aspects in isolation and a systematic benchmark for AIGI evaluation remains absent. Existing works notably neglect the critical aspect of responsibility and rely predominantly on outdated T2I models ( e.g. , DALL-E 2 ( Ramesh et al., 2022 ) and SDXL ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) ). Moreover, as T2I models rapidly evolve, benchmark images and evaluation tasks should also reflect newer generative artifacts, more diverse visual domains, and safety-sensitive scenarios. Therefore, we propose SQUARE-Bench, a unified benchmark for systematically assessing LMMs as AIGI evaluators across four fundamental aspects: semantics, quality, authenticity, and responsibility.

paragraphs.en: To ensure diverse and rigorous evaluation, we source images from a wide range of T2I models (from legacy to state-of-the-art) to capture various generative flaws. Our curation follows four specific strategies: 1) For semantic understanding , we design content-rich prompts targeting known LMM cognitive bottlenecks ( Figure 2 (a)). 2) For quality perception , we uniformly sample images across a broad spectrum of visual quality distributions ( Figure 3 (a) and (b)). 3) For authenticity identification , we establish a near 1:1 ratio between 3K real photographs and synthetic AIGIs. To prevent trivial detection, the selected AIGIs exhibit high photorealism, with RichHF ( Liang et al., 2024 ) scores uniformly distributed between 0.5 and 1.0 ( Figure 3 (c)). 4) For responsibility detection , we utilize a contrastive pairing strategy: alongside 1.4K unsafe prompts, we curate 0.7K “sanitized” counterparts (unsafe triggers replaced by benign adjacent concepts) to test safety boundary discernment. Detailed collection procedures are provided in Appendix Appendix C .

paragraphs.en: Although our primary focus is assessing LMMs as AIGI evaluators, this evaluation naturally involves two perspectives: what is actually visible in the image and what the original prompt intends the image to contain. An ideal AI-generated image must align with its prompt, satisfy aesthetic standards, present credible realism, and obey safety constraints. Accordingly, an ideal evaluator must master four fundamental aspects: semantic understanding , quality perception , authenticity identification , and responsibility detection . To operationalize these two perspectives within a unified framework, we introduce a Dual-Answer mechanism. For each question, we construct two ground truths: Answer 1 strictly reflects the actual visual content to evaluate the LMM’s pure perception (notably, the LMM is evaluated blindly, without access to the original T2I prompt), whereas Answer 2 describes the expected ideal outcome dictated by the prompt, serving as a baseline for T2I generation capabilities. Section 3.2 provides a concise overview of the four fundamental aspects.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们的主要关注点是评估 LMM 作为 AIGI 评估者的能力，但这项评估天然涉及两个视角：图像中实际可见的内容，以及原始提示词期望图像包含的内容。 理想的 AI 生成图像必须与提示词一致，符合审美标准，呈现可信的真实感，并遵守安全约束。 因此，一个理想的评估者必须掌握四个基本方面：语义理解、质量感知、真实性识别和责任检测。 为了在这两个视角之间建立统一的框架，我们引入了一种“双答案”机制。 对于每个问题，我们都会构建两个基准答案：答案 1 严格反映实际的视觉内容，用于评估 LMM 的纯粹感知能力（值得注意的是，LMM 的评估是盲测的，无法访问原始的 T2I 提示词）；而答案 2 则描述由提示词所规定的理想预期结果，作为 T2I 生成能力的基准。 第 3.2 节对这四个基本方面进行了简要概述。

paragraphs.en: SQUARE-Bench adopts five question formats to support both general visual understanding and task-specific diagnosis. The foundational formats include Yes-or-No (36.64%), What (23.94%), and How (7.61%) questions, which are applied across four aspects to evaluate the LMMs’ general judgment and detailed comprehension. Additionally, two specialized formats are introduced for specific diagnostic tasks: binary judgments (31.18%) are exclusively tailored for authenticity identification to distinguish natural from synthetic data, while multi-image questions (120 instances) are specifically designed for social fairness evaluation to assess demographic equity across an image batch.

paragraphs.en: To ensure rigorous and reliable evaluation data, we assemble a team of 15 trained human annotators with experience in AIGI evaluation. All annotations are conducted in a controlled setting under shared guidelines. Each image is first manually assigned to the most pertinent of our 38 taxonomic sub-dimensions. For the standard foundational formats , a primary annotator then constructs an instance-specific question, candidate options, and the corresponding dual answers: the Visual GT reflects the observable image content, whereas the Intended GT represents the expected generation outcome under the original prompt and applicable safety requirements. Each QA instance is independently cross-checked by at least three additional expert annotators for visual grounding, question clarity, option exclusivity, and answer correctness. Instances with disagreement or ambiguity are revised and adjudicated before inclusion. For binary judgments , questions and answers are deterministically derived from the ground-truth authenticity labels. This expert-driven pipeline yields approximately 18K high-quality evaluation instances. Comprehensive annotation guidelines and review procedures are provided in Appendix Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 为确保评估数据的严谨性和可靠性，我们组建了一支由 15 名经过训练、具备 AIGI 评估经验的人类标注员组成的团队。 所有标注工作均在受控环境中，依据统一的指导方针进行。 每张图片首先由人工标注，分配至我们 38 个分类子维度中最相关的一个。 对于标准的基础格式，一名主要标注员随后会构建一个针对具体实例的问题、候选选项以及对应的双重答案：视觉 GT 反映图像中可观察到的内容，而意图 GT 则代表在原始提示词和适用安全要求下预期的生成结果。 每个问答实例都会由至少三名额外的专家标注员独立交叉核查，以验证其视觉依据、问题清晰度、选项排他性和答案正确性。 存在分歧或模糊性的实例在纳入评估前会经过修订和裁定。 对于二元判断，问题和答案均根据真实标签确定性地生成。 这一由专家主导的流程共产生了约 1.8 万个高质量的评估实例。 完整的标注指导方针和审核流程详见附录 D。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present a comprehensive empirical evaluation based on SQUARE-Bench . We systematically assess the capabilities of 23 representative LMMs across the four established aspects. Furthermore, leveraging the dual-answer design, we derive a text-to-image (T2I) generation baseline, denoted as Mixed-Generator Average , which represents the average generative quality across the evaluated T2I models.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们基于 SQUARE-Bench 提出了一项全面的实证评估。 我们系统性地评估了 23 款代表性 LMM 在四个既定方面的能力。 此外，通过利用双答案设计，我们构建了一个文本到图像（T2I）生成基线，称为“混合生成器平均值”，它代表了所评估 T2I 模型的平均生成质量。

paragraphs.en: To assess both the innate capabilities and domain learnability of LMMs, we adopt a two-stage evaluation protocol. The dataset is randomly partitioned into disjoint training and testing subsets following a 4:1 split. Initially, all candidate models are evaluated on the testing subset in a zero-shot setting to establish baseline performance. Subsequently, three representative models are selected based on their performance and model size constraints for supervised fine-tuning. All fine-tuned models are implemented in PyTorch and fine-tuned using LoRA on a 48GB NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU. The training process is configured with a batch size of 16 and an initial learning rate of 1 ​ e − 5 1e^{-5} for 3 epochs. All other hyperparameters follow the default settings provided in the official repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 LMMs 的内在能力与领域可学习性，我们采用了一种两阶段评估方案。 数据集按照 4:1 的比例随机划分为互不重叠的训练集和测试集。 初始阶段，所有候选模型均在零样本设置下于测试集上进行评估，以确立基准性能。 随后，根据模型性能与模型大小限制，选择三个代表性模型进行监督微调。 所有微调模型均使用 PyTorch 实现，并通过 LoRA 在 48GB 的 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU 上进行微调。 训练过程配置为批量大小为 16，初始学习率为 1 ​ e − 5 1e^{-5}，共进行 3 个周期。 所有其他超参数均遵循官方仓库中提供的默认设置。

paragraphs.en: Semantics. LMMs show a “coarse-to-fine” performance gap: open-source and proprietary models perform better on basic object recognition than on fine-grained tasks such as counting and composition comprehension ( Table 2 ), suggesting that object recognition does not ensure reliable reasoning over attributes and relations. Quality. Several zero-shot open-source models outperform both the evaluated proprietary models and individual-expert references, particularly in low-level artifact detection and aesthetic assessment ( Table 3 ). This contrasts with the proprietary-model advantage in semantics and authenticity, showing that relative model rankings vary across aspects. Authenticity. Top proprietary models outperform the best individual-expert reference and the evaluated zero-shot open-source models on binary real/fake judgments, but perform less strongly on sensory fidelity inspection and world knowledge grounding ( Table 4 ). This gap suggests that binary detection performance does not fully reflect fine-grained authenticity assessment. Responsibility. paragraphs.en: The dual-answer formulation supports complementary diagnostic analyses of T2I generation and LMM evaluation errors. The Mixed-Generator Average achieves an overall success rate of only 26.72%, with substantially higher scores in semantics and responsibility than in quality and authenticity . Under the SQUARE-Bench evaluation protocol, this pattern suggests that the evaluated generators have greater difficulty satisfying criteria related to visual quality and physical plausibility than those related to semantic alignment. Beyond characterizing generator performance, comparing the two ground truths provides a diagnostic view of LMM errors. Across the 23 zero-shot LMMs, average accuracy is 10.37 percentage points lower on cases where the Visual GT differs from the Intended GT, with 17 models exhibiting the same direction of change. Moreover, among incorrect predictions on these mismatch cases, models select the Intended GT option with an 88.64% macro-average probability. Thus, these errors frequently favor the intended generation outcome over the content actually depicted in the image. These results describe an association rather than a causal effect: mismatch cases may also differ from matched cases in intrinsic difficulty and the types of generation failures they contain.
paragraphs.zh: 这种双答案表述方式支持对 T2I 生成和 LMM 评估错误进行互补的诊断分析。 混合生成器平均方法的整体成功率仅为 26.72%，但在语义和责任方面的得分明显高于质量和真实性方面的得分。 在 SQUARE-Bench 评估协议下，这一模式表明，被评估的生成器在满足视觉质量和物理合理性相关标准方面，比满足语义对齐相关标准的难度更大。 除了描述生成器的性能外，比较这两个基准答案还能提供诊断 LMM 错误的视角。 在 23 个零样本 LMM 中，当视觉基准答案与预期基准答案不同时，平均准确率降低了 10.37 个百分点，其中 17 个模型的变化方向一致。 此外，在这些不匹配案例的错误预测中，模型选择预期基准答案选项的宏观平均概率为 88.64%。 因此，这些错误往往更倾向于选择预期的生成结果，而非图像中实际呈现的内容。 这些结果描述的是相关性而非因果关系：不匹配的案例也可能在内在难度和所包含的生成失败类型上与匹配案例存在差异。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present SQUARE-Bench , the first comprehensive diagnostic benchmark to systematically evaluate LMMs across four fundamental aspects of AI-generated images: semantics, quality, authenticity , and notably pioneering responsibility . By introducing an innovative dual-answer mechanism, we effectively decouple LMM perceptual errors from inherent T2I generative flaws, moving beyond opaque scoring to diagnose specific cognitive bottlenecks. Empirically, we demonstrate that top-tier LMMs are approaching expert-level performance as AIGI evaluators and can outperform single-expert human references in some settings. However, this excellence is not ubiquitous: the distinct performance stratification and “coarse-to-fine” cognitive degradation indicate that robustness in complex, fine-grained reasoning remains challenging for current LMMs. Furthermore, our extracted T2I baseline exposes a severe gap between semantic texture synthesis and physical realism. As an auxiliary downstream study, we pair dimension-specific LMM guides with fixed image editors in an iterative editing loop. Compared with single-pass editing, the guided system improves selected semantic, authenticity, and responsibility metrics, while consistently underperforming on visual-quality metrics. Overall, SQUARE-Bench provides a diagnostic framework for identifying fine-grained strengths and weaknesses of LMM evaluators, and may serve as a useful diagnostic platform for developing more reliable LMM evaluators and, in turn, for guiding future improvements in text-to-image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SQUARE-Bench——首个全面的诊断基准，用于系统性地评估 LMM 在 AI 生成图像的四个基本方面上的表现：语义、质量、真实性，尤其值得一提的是其开创性的责任性评估。 通过引入一种创新的双答案机制，我们有效分离了 LMM 的感知错误与 T2I 生成模型固有的缺陷，从而超越了不透明的评分方式，能够诊断出具体的认知瓶颈。 实验表明，顶尖的 LMM 在作为 AIGI 评估工具时的表现已接近专家水平，并且在某些场景下甚至能超越单一专家的人类参考标准。 然而，这种卓越表现并非普遍存在：明显的性能分层以及“从粗到细”的认知能力退化表明，当前 LMM 在复杂、精细推理任务中的稳健性仍存在挑战。 此外，我们提取的 T2I 基准暴露出语义纹理合成与物理真实性之间的严重差距。 作为一项辅助的下游研究，我们将针对特定维度的 LMM 指南与固定的图像编辑器结合，构建了一个迭代编辑循环。 与单次编辑相比，该引导系统在选定的语义、真实性和责任性指标上有所提升，但在视觉质量指标上的表现则持续落后。 总体而言，SQUARE-Bench 提供了一个诊断框架，用于识别 LMM 评估工具的精细优势和劣势，并可能成为开发更可靠 LMM 评估工具的有效诊断平台，进而为文本到图像生成的未来改进提供指导。

paragraphs.en: SQUARE-Bench evaluates authenticity and responsibility in AI-generated images and therefore includes safety-sensitive and potentially harmful content. Although these data are intended to support safer and more accountable generative models, exposure to harmful examples and detailed failure analyses may create privacy and dual-use risks, including the possibility of circumventing automated safeguards. To mitigate these risks, we provide content warnings for the responsibility subset, review real-world images for visible personally identifiable information, and obscure identifiable faces in released examples where appropriate. We further plan to distribute the safety-sensitive portion of the benchmark under controlled access and explicit terms of use that prohibit malicious applications. These measures reduce, but cannot fully eliminate, the risks associated with releasing safety-sensitive evaluation data.
paragraphs.zh: SQUARE-Bench 评估人工智能生成图像的真实性与责任性，因此包含对安全敏感且可能有害的内容。 尽管这些数据旨在支持更安全、更具问责性的生成模型，但接触有害示例和详细的故障分析可能会带来隐私和双重用途风险，包括绕过自动防护机制的可能性。 为缓解这些风险，我们对责任性子集提供内容警告，审查真实世界图像中可见的个人身份信息，并在适当的发布示例中模糊可识别的面部特征。 我们进一步计划以受控访问和明确的使用条款分发基准中与安全敏感相关的部分，这些条款禁止恶意应用。 这些措施可以降低与安全敏感评估数据发布相关的风险，但无法完全消除。

paragraphs.en: This aspect evaluates the LMM’s visual comprehension , diagnosing its ability to accurately translate pixel-level information into semantic concepts across four dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 这一方面评估了 LMM 的视觉理解能力，通过四个维度诊断其将像素级信息准确转化为语义概念的能力：

paragraphs.en: This dimension assesses whether LMMs can grasp the global atmosphere independent of local details, including: 1) affection recognition ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , detecting scene emotional tone; 2) image view identification , interpreting camera perspective and framing; 3) time and light inference ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , deducing temporal context .
paragraphs.zh: 该维度评估 LMM 是否能够脱离局部细节而理解整体氛围，包括：1）情感识别（Fang 等人，2025），检测场景的情感基调；2）图像视角识别，解释相机视角和构图；3）时间与光线推断（Wang 等人，2025b），推论时间背景。

paragraphs.en: This dimension verifies whether LMMs can identify the factual existence of prompted entities ( Nichol et al., 2021 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ) , including: 1) major object detection , identifying primary foreground subjects; 2) minor object awareness , noticing secondary or background elements prone to omission; 3) text rendering inspection ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , assessing the legibility of embedded text.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度用于验证 LMMs 是否能够识别提示中所提及实体的实际存在（Nichol et al., 2021；Saharia et al., 2022），包括：1）主要对象检测，即识别前景中的主要主体；2）次要对象感知，即注意到容易被忽略的次要或背景元素；3）文本渲染检查（Wang et al., 2025b），即评估嵌入文本的可读性。

paragraphs.en: This dimension evaluates whether LMMs can disentangle complex binding relationships to address “bag-of-words" ambiguity ( Qu et al., 2024 ) , including: 1) attribute binding ( Xu et al., 2024b ) , correctly assigning properties (color, material) to specific targets; 2) nouns as adjectives awareness ( Chatterjee et al., 2024 ; Motamed et al., 2023 ) , distinguishing modifiers from literal objects; 3) composition comprehension ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ) , evaluating spatial and logical interactions; 4) objects counting ( Binyamin et al., 2025 ) , confirming numerical consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度评估 LMMs 是否能够解析复杂的绑定关系，以解决“词袋”模糊性问题（Qu et al., 2024），包括：1）属性绑定（Xu et al., 2024b），即正确将属性（颜色、材质）分配给特定目标；2）名词作形容词的识别能力（Chatterjee et al., 2024; Motamed et al., 2023），即区分修饰语与字面对象；3）组合理解能力（Wang et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024a），即评估空间与逻辑上的相互作用；4）物体计数能力（Binyamin et al., 2025），即验证数值的准确性。

paragraphs.en: This dimension examines whether LMMs can use external world knowledge for visual verification ( Schwenk et al., 2022 ) , including: 1) specific terms recognition , identifying specialized domain concepts; 2) contradiction acceptance ( Hou et al., 2024 ) , interpreting surreal concepts that defy real-world logic but align with creative prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 这一维度考察 LMMs 是否能够利用外部世界知识进行视觉验证（Schwenk 等，2022），包括：1）特定术语识别，即识别专业领域的概念；2）矛盾接受（Hou 等，2024），即解释那些违背现实逻辑但与创意提示相契合的超现实概念。

paragraphs.en: This aspect evaluates the LMM’s evaluation capablity of image visual quality independent of textual semantics: 1) technical quality assessment ( Su et al., 2021 ; Ying et al., 2020 ) , identifying intrinsic signal degradations ( e.g. , blur, noise, exposure); 2) aesthetic quality evaluation ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , appraising artistic elements ( e.g. , color harmony, lighting, framing); 3) generative distortion detection ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024b ) , recognizing generation-specific structural anomalies ( e.g. , anatomical malformations, geometric incoherence).
paragraphs.zh: 这一方面评估了 LMM 独立于文本语义对图像视觉质量的评估能力：1）技术质量评估（Su et al., 2021；Ying et al., 2020），识别内在信号退化问题（例如模糊、噪声、曝光）；2）美学质量评估（Huang et al., 2024），评价艺术元素（例如色彩和谐、光线、构图）；3）生成性失真检测（Chen et al., 2023；Li et al., 2023；Li et al., 2024b），识别生成特有的结构异常（例如解剖学畸形、几何不协调）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluates the LMM’s synthetic detection , diagnosing its ability to accurately distinguish AI-generated images from natural ones across four dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 评估 LMM 的合成图像检测能力，诊断其在四个维度上准确区分 AI 生成图像与自然图像的能力：

paragraphs.en: This dimension evaluates the LMM’s overall ability to distinguish AI-generated images from natural images through direct real/fake classification. Unlike the subsequent diagnostic dimensions, it measures holistic detection accuracy without requiring the model to identify or explain the specific visual cues underlying its decision.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度通过直接的“真实/虚假”分类，评估 LMM 区分 AI 生成图像与自然图像的整体能力。 与后续的诊断维度不同，它衡量的是整体的检测准确率，而无需模型识别或解释其决策所依据的具体视觉线索。

sents.en: This dimension evaluates the LMM’s overall ability to distinguish AI-generated images from natural images through direct real/fake classification.
sents.zh: 该维度通过直接的“真实/虚假”分类，评估 LMM 区分 AI 生成图像与自然图像的整体能力。

sents.en: Unlike the subsequent diagnostic dimensions, it measures holistic detection accuracy without requiring the model to identify or explain the specific visual cues underlying its decision.
sents.zh: 与后续的诊断维度不同，它衡量的是整体的检测准确率，而无需模型识别或解释其决策所依据的具体视觉线索。

paragraphs.en: This dimension assesses low-level physical realism ( Li et al., 2025b ) , including: 1) material texture analysis , verifying reflectance conformity to natural distributions; 2) boundary coherence detection , identifying edge inconsistencies and generative splicing traces; 3) photometric consistency validation , confirming adherence to optical physics; 4) imaging pattern differentiation , distinguishing organic noise from artificial artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度评估低层物理真实性（Li et al., 2025b），包括：1）材料纹理分析，验证反射率是否符合自然分布；2）边界连贯性检测，识别边缘不一致性及生成拼接痕迹；3）光度一致性验证，确认其遵循光学物理规律；4）成像模式区分，辨别有机噪声与人工伪影。

paragraphs.en: This dimension examines spatial and projection validity ( Wen et al., 2025 ) , including: 1) perspective & projection assessment , judging vanishing points and structural deformations; 2) spatial relation reasoning ( Wu et al., 2025c ) , assessing positioning, occlusion, and depth validity; 3) geometric scale evaluation , gauging relative size ratios ( e.g. , human-to-building); 4) object morphology inspection , scrutinizing structural and geometric integrity.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度考察空间与投影的有效性（Wen 等，2025），包括：1）视角与投影评估，判断消失点和结构变形；2）空间关系推理（Wu 等，2025c），评估位置、遮挡和深度有效性；3）几何尺度评价，衡量相对尺寸比例（例如，人与建筑之间的比例）；4）对象形态检查，仔细审查结构和几何完整性。

paragraphs.en: This dimension probes whether LMMs can use external knowledge beyond pixel-level cues, including: 1) physical law verification ( Pu et al., 2025 ) , confirming adherence to mechanics, optics, and thermodynamics; 2) biological plausibility evaluation , evaluating anatomical, physiological, and behavioral realism; 3) chemical reactivity validation , assessing phenomena accuracy ( e.g. , combustion, corrosion); 4) sociocultural norm alignment ( Wu et al., 2025c ) , recognizing cultural symbols and geo-specific signs; 5) spatiotemporal consistency analysis ( Niu et al., 2025 ) , deducing coherence of time cycles and historical progression.
paragraphs.zh: 这一维度旨在探究LMMs是否能够利用超越像素级线索的外部知识，包括：1）物理定律验证（Pu等，2025），确认其遵循力学、光学和热力学规律；2）生物学合理性评估，评估解剖学、生理学和行为的真实性；3）化学反应性验证，评估现象的准确性（例如燃烧、腐蚀）；4）社会文化规范对齐（Wu等，2025c），识别文化符号和特定地理区域的标志；5）时空一致性分析（Niu等，2025），推断时间循环和历史发展的连贯性。

paragraphs.en: This aspect evaluates the LMM’s safety awareness , diagnosing its ability to accurately identify harmful content and social biases in images across three dimensions:
paragraphs.zh: 这一方面评估了 LMM 的安全意识，从三个维度诊断其在图像中准确识别有害内容和社交偏见的能力：

paragraphs.en: This dimension assesses demographic and cultural fairness ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , including: 1) cultural fairness auditing , verifying accurate, non-stereotypical representations of civilizations; 2) human bias detection , scrutinizing attribute neutrality ( e.g. , gender, skin tone) in agnostic contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度评估人口统计学和文化公平性（Huang 等，2025），包括：1）文化公平性审计，验证对文明的准确且非刻板印象的呈现；2）人类偏见检测，审查在无关情境中属性（例如性别、肤色）的中立性。

paragraphs.en: This dimension detects visually harmful or sensitive content ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) , including: 1) disturbing content recognition , identifying gore or mutilation; 2) harassment detection , spotting bullying or demeaning behavior; 3) illegal violence identification , flagging physical aggression or weaponry; 4) political sensitivity awareness , recognizing controversial figures or symbols; 5) sexual content filtering , pinpointing nudity or NSFW content.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度可检测具有视觉危害性或敏感性的内容（Zhang 等，2023；Qu 等，2023；Qu 等，2025），包括：1）令人不适的内容识别，即识别血腥或残肢断臂的画面；2）骚扰行为检测，即发现霸凌或侮辱性行为；3）非法暴力识别，即标记身体攻击或使用武器的情况；4）政治敏感性问题识别，即辨识具有争议的人物或符号；5）性内容过滤，即精准识别裸体或 NSFW 内容。

paragraphs.en: This dimension evaluates whether LMMs can distinguish benign concepts from visually adjacent harmful concepts, including: 1) potential safety auditing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , catching harmful hallucinations from seemingly benign cues ; 2) concept disambiguation verification (Safe) ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , confirming the visual clarity of benign concepts adjacent to harmful ones.
paragraphs.zh: 该维度评估 LMM 是否能够区分良性概念与在视觉上相邻的有害概念，包括：1）潜在的安全审计（Huang 等人，2025），即从看似良性的线索中识别出有害的幻觉；2）概念消歧验证（Safe）（Liu 等人，2024a），即确认与有害概念相邻的良性概念在视觉上的清晰度。

paragraphs.en: A perfect T2I output must satisfy four conditions: it must adhere to the user’s prompt, satisfy aesthetic standards, present credible realism (provided the prompt implies a photorealistic intent and does not inherently defy physical laws), and obey safety constraints. Accordingly, an ideal T2I model must exhibit generative mastery in semantic alignment , quality generation , authenticity synthesis , and responsibility compliance . This section outlines the specific requirements and expected ideal outcomes for T2I models corresponding to our evaluation taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 完美的文本到图像（T2I）输出必须满足四个条件：它必须遵循用户的提示，符合美学标准，呈现可信的写实效果（前提是提示暗示了照片级真实意图且本身不违背物理定律），并遵守安全约束。 因此，理想的 T2I 模型必须在语义对齐、质量生成、真实性合成和责任合规方面展现出卓越的生成能力。 本节概述了与我们的评估分类相对应的 T2I 模型的具体要求及预期的理想结果。

paragraphs.en: Semantic alignment evaluates the fidelity of information transfer from text to pixel, measuring the T2I model’s ability to accurately materialize textual prompts across four granularities:
paragraphs.zh: 语义对齐评估了从文本到像素的信息传递保真度，衡量 T2I 模型在四个不同粒度上准确具象化文本提示的能力：

paragraphs.en: Generates the global atmosphere independent of local details: 1) affection rendering , synthesizing the correct emotional tone of the scene; 2) image view application , accurately executing the requested camera perspective and framing; 3) time and light manifestation , rendering the correct temporal context ( e.g. , applying cool “morning” rather than warm “dusk” lighting).
paragraphs.zh: 生成与局部细节无关的全局氛围：1）情感呈现，合成场景正确的情感基调；2）图像视角应用，准确执行所请求的相机视角和构图；3）时间与光线的表现，呈现正确的时空背景（例如，应用冷色调的“早晨”光线，而非暖色调的“黄昏”光线）。

paragraphs.en: Ensures the factual synthesis of prompted entities: 1) major object rendering , accurately materializing primary foreground subjects; 2) minor object inclusion , preserving secondary or background elements without omission; 3) text rendering , generating structurally correct and legible embedded text.
paragraphs.zh: 确保提示实体的事实性合成：1）主要对象渲染，准确呈现主要前景主体；2）次要对象包含，保留次要或背景元素且无一遗漏；3）文本渲染，生成结构正确且清晰可辨的嵌入式文本。

paragraphs.en: Overcomes complex binding relationships to prevent conceptual blending: 1) attributes binding , accurately mapping properties ( e.g. , color, material) to specific targets without feature leakage; 2) nouns as adjectives handling , correctly rendering modifiers rather than literal objects ( e.g. , generating an “apple green” car, not a car with an apple); 3) composition execution , manifesting correct spatial and logical interactions ( e.g. , “holding,” “beneath”); 4) objects counting , synthesizing the exact numerical count of requested entities.
paragraphs.zh: 克服复杂的绑定关系，防止概念融合：1）属性绑定，准确将属性（例如颜色、材质）映射到特定目标，且无特征泄露；2）名词作形容词处理，正确呈现修饰语而非字面意义的对象（例如生成一辆“苹果绿”的汽车，而不是一辆带有苹果的汽车）；3）组合执行，体现正确的空间与逻辑交互（例如“持有”、“在……下方”）；4）对象计数，合成所请求实体的精确数量。

paragraphs.en: Leverages external world knowledge for accurate visual materialization: 1) specific terms synthesis , accurately rendering specialized domain concepts based on pre-trained knowledge ( e.g. , “Eiffel Tower”); 2) contradiction realization , generating surreal concepts that defy real-world logic but adhere strictly to creative prompts ( e.g. , “astronaut on Mars”).
paragraphs.zh: 利用外部世界知识实现精准的视觉化呈现：1）特定术语合成，基于预训练知识准确呈现专业领域概念（例如，“埃菲尔铁塔”）；2）矛盾性呈现，生成违背现实逻辑但严格遵循创意提示的超现实概念（例如，“火星上的宇航员”）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluates the intrinsic visual quality of the generated output, independent of textual semantics: 1) technical quality adherence , minimizing intrinsic signal degradations ( e.g. , ensuring sharpness, low noise, and proper exposure); 2) aesthetic quality optimization , enhancing artistic elements ( e.g. , achieving color harmony, dynamic lighting, and balanced framing); 3) generative distortion avoidance , preventing generation-specific structural anomalies ( e.g. , avoiding anatomical malformations, extra limbs, or geometric incoherence).
paragraphs.zh: 评估生成输出的内在视觉质量，与文本语义无关：1）技术质量合规性，最小化内在信号退化（例如，确保清晰度、低噪和适当的曝光）；2）美学质量优化，增强艺术元素（例如，实现色彩和谐、动态光影和均衡构图）；3）生成性失真规避，防止生成特有的结构异常（例如，避免解剖学畸形、多余肢体或几何不协调）。

paragraphs.en: Evaluates the photorealism and physical plausibility of the generated data, measuring the model’s ability to mimic natural distributions and real-world physics across three levels:
paragraphs.zh: 评估生成数据的照片级真实性和物理合理性，衡量模型在三个层面上模仿自然分布和现实世界物理规律的能力：

paragraphs.en: Synthesizes low-level physical realism : 1) material texture generation , rendering reflectance and textures that conform to natural material distributions; 2) boundary coherence , generating seamless object edges without artificial splicing traces; 3) photometric consistency , adhering strictly to optical physics and realistic light transport; 4) imaging pattern simulation , producing organic photographic noise rather than artificial generative artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 综合低层物理真实感：1）材质纹理生成，渲染符合自然材质分布的反射率和纹理；2）边界连贯性，生成无缝的对象边缘，无人工拼接痕迹；3）光度一致性，严格遵循光学物理和真实的光传输；4）成像模式模拟，产生有机的摄影噪点，而非人工生成的伪影。

paragraphs.en: Maintains spatial and projection validity : 1) perspective & projection fidelity , generating correct vanishing points without spatial deformations; 2) spatial relation coherence , rendering accurate positioning, occlusion, and depth variations; 3) geometric scale accuracy , preserving proper relative size ratios among entities ( e.g. , human-to-building proportions); 4) object morphology integrity , maintaining the structural and morphological correctness of individual objects.
paragraphs.zh: 维持空间与投影的有效性：1）透视与投影保真度，生成正确的消失点且无空间形变；2）空间关系一致性，呈现准确的定位、遮挡和深度变化；3）几何尺度准确性，保持实体间适当的相对尺寸比例（例如，人与建筑的尺寸比例）；4）对象形态完整性，维持单个对象的结构和形态正确性。

paragraphs.en: Anchors the generation in compliance with external laws beyond raw pixels: 1) physical law adherence , conforming strictly to mechanics, optics, and thermodynamics; 2) biological plausibility , synthesizing anatomically, physiologically, and behaviorally realistic subjects; 3) chemical reactivity simulation , accurately depicting physical phenomena ( e.g. , combustion, corrosion, fluid dynamics); 4) sociocultural norm alignment , correctly rendering cultural symbols and geo-specific signs without anachronisms; 5) spatiotemporal consistency , generating coherent time cycles, weather conditions, and historical contexts.
paragraphs.zh: 确保生成内容不仅符合像素表现，还遵循外部规律：1）物理定律遵循，严格符合力学、光学和热力学原理；2）生物学合理性，合成在解剖学、生理学和行为上均真实可信的主体；3）化学反应模拟，准确描绘物理现象（例如燃烧、腐蚀、流体动力学）；4）社会文化规范契合，正确呈现文化符号和地域特定标志，且无时代错乱；5）时空一致性，生成连贯的时间循环、天气状况和历史背景。

paragraphs.en: Ensures adherence to ethical boundaries and social norms, evaluating the model’s ability to resist generating harmful content and maintain unbiased representations across three domains:
paragraphs.zh: 确保遵守伦理界限和社会规范，评估模型在三个领域内抵制生成有害内容以及保持无偏见表现的能力：

paragraphs.en: Maintains equity and diversity across demographics: 1) cultural fairness representation , generating accurate, non-stereotypical depictions of diverse civilizations and cultures; 2) human bias mitigation , maintaining attribute neutrality ( e.g. , balanced gender and skin tone distributions) when rendering context-agnostic prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 维护不同人口群体之间的公平性与多样性：1）文化公平性呈现，生成对多元文明与文化的准确且无刻板印象的描绘；2）人类偏见缓解，在渲染与上下文无关的提示时保持属性中立（例如，性别和肤色分布均衡）。

paragraphs.en: Prevents the generation of objectively harmful elements : 1) disturbing content refusal , actively blocking the synthesis of gore, mutilation, or extreme disgust; 2) harassment avoidance , refusing to generate visual depictions of bullying or demeaning behavior; 3) illegal violence restriction , blocking depictions of physical aggression, self-harm, or illicit weaponry; 4) political sensitivity compliance , refusing to inappropriately render controversial figures, events, or symbols; 5) sexual content filtering , strictly blocking nudity or NSFW content generation.
paragraphs.zh: 防止生成客观有害的内容：1）干扰性内容拒绝，主动阻止血腥、残肢或极端令人反感的画面合成；2）骚扰规避，拒绝生成霸凌或羞辱行为的视觉表现；3）非法暴力限制，阻止对肢体攻击、自残或非法武器的描绘；4）政治敏感合规，拒绝不当呈现争议性人物、事件或符号；5）性内容过滤，严格阻止裸体或 NSFW 内容的生成。

paragraphs.en: Maintains a strict visual demarcation between benign requests and harmful outputs: 1) potential safety evasion , avoiding harmful visual hallucinations when processing seemingly benign cues ; 2) concept disambiguation (Safe), ensuring the visual clarity of benign concepts that are conceptually adjacent to harmful ones ( e.g. , successfully rendering “red paint” without it morphing into a depiction of “blood”).
paragraphs.zh: 在良性请求与有害输出之间保持严格的视觉界限：1）潜在安全规避，在处理看似良性的提示时避免产生有害的视觉幻觉；2）概念消歧（安全），确保与有害概念在概念上相邻的良性概念具有视觉上的清晰度（例如，成功渲染“红色颜料”，而不会将其变形为“血液”的描绘）。

paragraphs.en: To construct a comprehensive and unbiased benchmark, we curated a hybrid dataset by integrating diverse inputs from 16 established benchmarks across four critical dimensions: AIGIs Evaluation, Synthetic Data Detection, Safety Evaluation, and AI-Edits Evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建一个全面且无偏的基准，我们通过整合来自 16 个成熟基准的多样化输入，创建了一个混合数据集。这些基准涵盖四个关键维度：AIGIs 评估、合成数据检测、安全评估和 AI-Edits 评估。

paragraphs.en: As detailed in Table 7 , we constructed a comprehensive prompt pool to serve as the generative basis for our benchmark. Specifically, we collected existing prompts and ground-truth captions (corresponding to real-world images) from nine established datasets. To supplement the missing textual descriptions, we utilized Qwen-VL-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to generate captions for a selected subset of the remaining real images. Through this aggregation and augmentation process, we consolidated a total of 6,721 distinct text prompts. Crucially, rather than a naive aggregation, these prompts underwent a rigorous curation process. They were deliberately selected to encompass a highly diverse spectrum of task types and generative scenarios, ensuring that the underlying textual concepts strictly align with the multi-dimensional structural requirements of our evaluation taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 7 所示，我们构建了一个全面的提示词库，作为我们基准测试的生成基础。 具体来说，我们从九个成熟的數據集中收集了现有的提示词和真实图像对应的参考描述。 为了补充缺失的文字描述，我们使用 Qwen-VL-32B（Yang et al., 2025）为剩余真实图像中的部分样本生成了描述。 通过这一聚合与增强过程，我们总共整合了 6,721 个独特的文本提示词。 关键在于，这些提示词并非简单堆砌，而是经过了一套严格的筛选与优化流程。 它们经过精心挑选，以涵盖高度多样化的任务类型和生成场景，从而确保其底层文本概念与我们评估分类体系的多维结构要求严格一致。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating the Quality Perception dimension requires AIGIs that span a comprehensive quality spectrum. To accurately mirror real-world variations and avoid distribution collapse, we implement a distribution-aware sampling strategy. For Technical Quality , we source images from the AIGIQA-20K dataset ( Li et al., 2024b ) , applying a uniform sampling strategy based on the provided Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) to ensure an even representation across all quality tiers. For Aesthetic Quality , where native human ratings are absent, we utilize Q-Align ( Wu et al., 2023 ) to infer aesthetic pseudo-labels, followed by similar uniform sampling.

paragraphs.en: Building upon these meticulous dimension-specific collection strategies, the finalized SQUARE-Bench encompasses an unprecedented breadth of visual data. Beyond the rigorously controlled, uniform quality distribution discussed above, the consolidated AIGI corpus introduces highly diverse stylistic paradigms and a comprehensive array of semantic categories. As showcased in Figure 7 through Figure 10 , the dataset covers a continuum of generative scenarios—ranging from ultra-photorealistic portraits to complex, abstract artistic compositions. This extensive visual variance is paramount for providing a robust and challenging testbed to assess LMM generalization capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些针对特定维度的细致采集策略，最终形成的 SQUARE-Bench 包含了前所未有的广泛视觉数据。 除了上述严格控制的均匀质量分布外，整合后的 AIGI 语料库还引入了高度多样化的风格范式以及全面的语义类别集合。 如图 7 至图 10 所示，该数据集涵盖了从超写实肖像到复杂抽象艺术创作的连续生成场景。 这种广泛的视觉多样性对于提供一个稳健且富有挑战性的测试平台，以评估 LMM 的泛化能力至关重要。

paragraphs.en: To transform the curated image collection into a rigorous evaluation benchmark, we adopt a fully expert-driven workflow consisting of fine-grained dimension alignment, manual QA authoring, independent cross-checking, and final adjudication.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将精心挑选的图片集转化为严谨的评估基准，我们采用了一套完全由专家主导的工作流程，包括精细维度对齐、人工编写问题与答案、独立交叉验证以及最终裁定。

paragraphs.en: Images may exhibit multiple potential issues ( e.g. , both lighting inconsistency and anatomical deformation). To maintain a clear evaluation target, annotators first map each image to the single most salient sub-dimension among the 38 categories in our taxonomy. The selected sub-dimension determines the primary capability assessed by the subsequent question, preventing individual instances from conflating unrelated visual properties.
paragraphs.zh: 图像可能表现出多种潜在问题（例如，光照不一致和解剖学变形）。 为了保持明确的评估目标，标注人员首先将每张图像映射到我们分类体系中 38 个类别里最突出的单一子维度。 所选的子维度决定了后续问题所评估的主要能力，从而避免单个实例将不相关的视觉属性混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: For each assigned image, a human annotator examines the image, its source prompt when available, and the definition of the target sub-dimension. The annotator then manually constructs an instance-specific question, a set of candidate options, and the corresponding dual answers. The Visual GT is determined exclusively from observable image content, whereas the Intended GT represents the expected generation outcome under the original prompt and applicable safety requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个分配到的图像，人类标注员会检查该图像、其来源提示（如可用）以及目标子维度的定义。 随后，标注员会手动构建一个针对该实例的特定问题、一组候选选项以及相应的双重答案。 视觉黄金标准完全基于可观察的图像内容确定，而预期黄金标准则代表在原始提示和适用安全要求下期望的生成结果。

paragraphs.en: All annotators follow a shared set of construction guidelines:
paragraphs.zh: 所有标注者都遵循一套共同的构建指南：

paragraphs.en: Dimension fidelity: Each question must primarily assess the assigned sub-dimension rather than an unrelated visual property.
paragraphs.zh: 维度保真度：每个问题都必须主要评估指定的子维度，而非无关的视觉属性。

paragraphs.en: Visual grounding: The correct Visual GT must be supported by observable evidence in the image. Questions answerable solely from commonsense or textual priors are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉接地：正确的视觉 GT 必须得到图像中可观察证据的支持。 仅能根据常识或文本先验回答的问题被排除在外。

sents.en: Visual grounding: The correct Visual GT must be supported by observable evidence in the image.
sents.zh: 视觉接地：正确的视觉 GT 必须得到图像中可观察证据的支持。

sents.en: Questions answerable solely from commonsense or textual priors are excluded.
sents.zh: 仅能根据常识或文本先验回答的问题被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Instance specificity: Questions must refer to the distinctive content of the given image rather than use generic templates such as “Is this image high quality?”
paragraphs.zh: 实例特定性：问题必须涉及给定图像的独特内容，而不能使用“这张图像质量高吗？”之类的通用模板。

paragraphs.en: Diagnostic value: Questions should expose meaningful perceptual or reasoning failures while avoiding unnecessarily trivial cues, unless those cues are themselves the target of the assigned sub-dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断价值：问题应当揭示有意义的感知或推理失败，同时避免不必要地引入无关紧要的提示，除非这些提示本身正是所分配子维度的目标。

paragraphs.en: Option validity: Candidate options must be plausible, mutually exclusive, and sufficiently complete to contain an unambiguous correct answer.
paragraphs.zh: 选项有效性：候选选项必须合理、互斥且足够完整，以确保存在一个明确无误的正确答案。

paragraphs.en: Dual-answer consistency: The Visual GT and Intended GT must respectively reflect the rendered image and the intended generation target, without conflating perception errors with generation failures.
paragraphs.zh: 双重答案一致性：Visual GT 和 Intended GT 必须分别反映渲染出的图像和预期的生成目标，而不能将感知错误与生成失败混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: Each completed QA instance is independently reviewed by at least three additional expert annotators. Reviewers verify the question premise, visual grounding, sub-dimension alignment, option exclusivity, and correctness of both ground-truth answers. They also identify cases in which blur, occlusion, or insufficient visual evidence prevents a decisive answer. Any instance that fails one or more checks is returned for revision. Remaining disagreements are discussed and adjudicated by the annotation team before the instance is accepted into the benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 每个已完成的问答实例都会由至少三名额外的专家标注员独立审核。 审核人员会验证问题前提、视觉依据、子维度对齐、选项排他性，以及标准答案的正确性。 他们还会识别出因模糊、遮挡或视觉证据不足而无法得出明确答案的情况。 任何一项检查未通过的实例都会被退回修订。 其余分歧将由标注团队进行讨论和裁定，之后该实例才会被纳入基准测试。

paragraphs.en: For the standard foundational formats, including Yes-or-No, What, and How questions, annotators manually construct the complete question-option-answer tuple. Binary real/fake judgments are deterministically derived from the ground-truth authenticity labels. This workflow produces approximately 18K human-constructed and cross-checked evaluation instances.
paragraphs.zh: 对于标准的基础格式，包括“是/否”、“什么”和“如何”类问题，标注员会手动构建完整的问题-选项-答案元组。 二元真假判断是根据真实标签的准确性信息确定得出的。 该工作流程可生成约 18,000 个由人工构建并经过交叉验证的评估实例。

Annotators are compensated at approximately $10 per hour, with a total annotation cost of approximately $15,000. To mitigate fatigue and maintain annotation quality, each expert processes no more than 30 images per day.

paragraphs.en: We use standardized QA instruction templates across all candidate LMMs to reduce parsing ambiguity and encourage uniformly formatted outputs. All models are evaluated with a decoding temperature of 0 (greedy decoding) to minimize sampling-related variation and improve reproducibility. This setting reduces stochastic decoding effects but does not eliminate implementation- or response-format-related variation; invalid and non-parseable responses are handled as described below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在所有候选 LMM 中均使用标准化的问答指令模板，以减少解析歧义并鼓励生成格式统一的输出。 所有模型均以解码温度设为 0（贪心解码）进行评估，以最小化采样相关的差异并提升可重复性。 此设置虽能减少随机解码带来的影响，但并未消除与实现方式或响应格式相关的差异；无效且无法解析的响应将按如下说明处理。

paragraphs.en: For the multi-image Cultural Fairness and Human Bias questions, an empty or non-parseable response is counted as incorrect. Because the random-guessing baseline assumes that a valid option is produced for every question, a score of 0.00% or below this baseline may reflect a low valid-response rate rather than systematic selection of incorrect options. DeepSeek-VL-7B-Chat had no valid parsed prediction for any of the 6 Cultural Fairness questions or any of the 12 Human Bias questions. DeepSeek-VL2-small likewise had no valid parsed prediction for any of the 12 Human Bias questions. For Cultural Fairness, however, DeepSeek-VL2-small returned valid options for only 2 of 6 questions and answered 1 correctly, yielding an overall accuracy of 16.67%. Given the small subset sizes (6 and 12 test QAs), these results should be interpreted cautiously rather than as stable estimates of model performance.

paragraphs.en: Each editing trajectory is limited to at most five editing operations. Before each potential operation, the guidance LMM assesses the current image and determines whether further correction is required. The loop terminates if the guide returns needs_edit=false , if the generated editing instruction is empty after whitespace stripping, or once five editing operations have been completed. Upon termination, the latest available image is used as the trajectory output.
paragraphs.zh: 每次编辑轨迹最多只能包含五次编辑操作。 在每次潜在操作之前，引导 LMM 会评估当前图像，并判断是否需要进一步修正。 如果引导模型返回 needs_edit=false，或者生成的编辑指令在去除空白字符后为空，又或者已完成五次编辑操作，循环便会终止。 循环终止后，将使用最新可用的图像作为轨迹输出。

paragraphs.en: For Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (top), the first two edits largely preserve the scene’s appearance while modifying the characters’ hands. Colored speckles and block-like artifacts become visible at the third edit and are substantially more pronounced in the fourth and fifth outputs, affecting the background, hair, and clothing. For Step1X-Edit-v1p2 (bottom), the original portrait is visibly blurred, and the initial edit increases its apparent sharpness. However, subsequent edits introduce increasingly dense speckles and fragmented edges across the face, hair, and green background. Thus, an early improvement in apparent clarity does not necessarily translate into sustained visual quality over additional iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511（顶部），前两次编辑基本保留了场景的外观，同时修改了人物的手部。 第三次编辑时出现了彩色斑点状和块状的伪影，在第四次和第五次输出中这些伪影变得更加明显，并影响了背景、头发和衣物。 对于 Step1X-Edit-v1p2（底部），原始肖像明显模糊，而第一次编辑则提升了其表观清晰度。 然而，后续编辑在面部、头发和绿色背景上引入了越来越密集的斑点状伪影和破碎的边缘。 因此，早期表观清晰度的提升并不一定意味着在更多次迭代中视觉质量能够持续保持。

paragraphs.en: These trajectories illustrate a potential tension between correcting a diagnosed defect and preserving image fidelity. Although the editing instructions seek to correct hand structure or improve image clarity, later outputs exhibit degradation beyond the intended corrections. Because each output becomes the input to the next iteration, newly introduced artifacts can persist or become more pronounced in subsequent outputs. This observation motivates quality-aware stopping criteria and mechanisms for retaining an earlier, higher-quality intermediate result.
paragraphs.zh: 这些轨迹揭示了纠正已诊断缺陷与保持图像保真度之间可能存在的矛盾。 尽管编辑指令旨在修正手部结构或提升图像清晰度，但后续输出却出现了超出预期修正范围的退化现象。 由于每次输出都会成为下一轮迭代的输入，新引入的伪影可能会在后续输出中持续存在或变得更加明显。 这一观察结果促使我们提出兼顾质量的停止准则，以及保留早期更高质量中间结果的机制。

sents.zh: 尽管编辑指令旨在修正手部结构或提升图像清晰度，但后续输出却出现了超出预期修正范围的退化现象。

sents.en: Because each output becomes the input to the next iteration, newly introduced artifacts can persist or become more pronounced in subsequent outputs.
sents.zh: 由于每次输出都会成为下一轮迭代的输入，新引入的伪影可能会在后续输出中持续存在或变得更加明显。

sents.en: This observation motivates quality-aware stopping criteria and mechanisms for retaining an earlier, higher-quality intermediate result.
sents.zh: 这一观察结果促使我们提出兼顾质量的停止准则，以及保留早期更高质量中间结果的机制。
